fields.description: Weekly issue featuring editorials and local reporting on Miami Beach gambling and enforcement (“Miami Beach is closed”), criticism of daily newspapers’ influence, and discussion of “liberal policy” and potential recall politics. Includes coverage of a criminal libel complaint involving Dorothy Brand and attorney/candidate Harry Zuckernick with references to Miami Beach councilman Melvin Richard; a Hialeah “Peeping Tom” case before Judge J. Lavery; calls for a referendum on Dade County’s extra-long school term; commentary on rent decontrol legislation and Gov. Fuller Warren; a physician fee dispute involving Dr. R. M. I. Edelman; and assorted civic/police-court notes and advertisements.
